title: Persona — World Delete — payload
description: Delete one world. The faces and attributes that belonged to it are untouched — a world is a way of arranging what the holder keeps, never a container for it.

expectedVersion.description: Optional precondition. Supply the version a prior read returned to refuse a delete against a world that has changed since it was looked at.

existed.description: False when there was nothing to delete. A successful no-op rather than an error: a producer retrying after a lost response must be able to reach the state it wanted without having to tell a second delete apart from a first.

releasedFaces.description: How many profiles no longer belong to any world as a result. Nothing was deleted and nothing changed about them — this is the count a consumer needs to say what the screen will look like afterwards, which is the honest end of a sentence that would otherwise read only 'deleted'.
